method: One actual saved street-camera render using Cycles CPU,8samples,denoising,960×540,max2threads. Render settings are temporary and never saved back to the native file.

observations: Road reads as rough, nonmetal paving with broad local variation and restrained sheen, not a continuous mirror.

limits: Eight CPU samples with denoising soften fine aggregate and can smooth small high-frequency details.
